description.value: BBT Café is a Taiwanese bubble tea restaurant and café in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood, serving a broad menu of traditional cold snacks, hot pot, noodles, soups, and toast alongside their signature bubble teas. The restaurant also carries wine, beer, and sake, making it a more substantial stop than the name alone suggests. Dine-in table booking and takeout are both available.

address.value: 5979 West Blvd, Vancouver, BC V6M 3X1, Canada

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 60m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 62m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address (5979 West Blvd) and provides a phone number (604) 266-2195 absent from OSM tags. The homepage explicitly states 'Dine In or Take Away', confirming takeout availability. Multiple menu items carry 'Vegetarian Vegan' labels and a dedicated 養生素食 HEALTHY VEGETARIAN section is listed, confirming vegetarian/vegan options; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; website provides (604) 266-2195 — added from website.
OSM closing time differs from the closing time stated on the website homepage; OSM data may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Taiwanese restaurant and bubble tea café with confirmed takeout and a broad menu including vegetarian options — a useful stop for touring cyclists.
